best_model.training_data: Joint LTMP, manta and MMP mortality observations
caveats: Gannett Cay 2020 remains a COTS-associated underprediction; treating its undated 9.9 COTS/tow RRN seasonal pressure as pre-bleaching lifts the held-out prediction to about 0.183 but does not resolve the full magnitude.
Penrith Reef 2017 remains underpredicted despite its Cyclone Debbie hazard uplift.
Mackay 2024 remains unresolved by the available freshwater and cyclone proxies.
The logistic cyclone activation centred at 20 damaging-wave hours is provisional for Jasper and Kirrily and must be retested with the forthcoming cyclone data and exposure uncertainty.

caveats.Targeted culling removals are retained a: adding removed COTS per dive and effort slightly worsened held-out transfer.

caveats: RRN event-season density has no within-season date and is assumed to precede bleaching mortality; exact-date Manta and culling information is limited to the end of February. The model combines raw RRN excess with latest/prior-three-year Manta pressure, time since peak and event-year hindcast probability.
Nested residual BRTs improve reef-blocked skill but worsen event-held-out overall and severe RMSE; they are not part of the operational ensemble.

Independent full-predictor direct and two-part BRTs, plus predictor-only environmental-envelope blends, improve some reef-blocked interpolation metrics but worsen new-event RMSE and severe RMSE. They are not used for the initial forecast; the direct BRT is retained for within-event interpolation and diagnostic sensitivity.

caveats.Spatially independent aerial/RHIS early-: the only aggregate RMSE gain is limited to 2016/2017/2020 and worsens severe-event RMSE, while RHIS-only transfer worsens the five-event forecast.

caveats: Cause labels are incomplete and annual coral-cover transitions can contain multiple simultaneous causes.
